title: Base MMS Initiate variant 2
purpose: Provide a plausible stateful association sequence with COTP data transfer followed by an MMS initiate-style confirmed request APDU carried over RFC1006.
expected_behavior: A peer already prepared for data transfer may accept the DT framing and parse the second frame as an initiate-style MMS request, or reject it cleanly if additional presentation/session wrapping is required by that stack.
constraints_preserved: Used the specified target operation exactly once.
Kept TPKT total length fields consistent with complete messages.
Used a two-message setup_then_request style sequence within budget.
Cited the supplied base constraint source id.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or external validation was available. The MMS initiate encoding is based on fallible model prior and is intended as a conservative structural seed only.
